She pauses after a rehearsal turn on a level granite path in a plum-orchard sculpture garden beside narrow curved ceramic fins. Both boot soles rest on the path; her torso turns gently toward the camera. Her left elbow is bent, with the open left palm at waist height outside the torso silhouette, echoing a nearby fin's curve; her relaxed right hand hangs beside her hip, clear of the skirt. The ceramic fin stands beyond her fingertips. Her ash-blond wig forms two long hair tails tied high on opposite sides of her head, descending forward outside her upper arms; angular pewter ornaments mark both tie points. On her head, paired compact ear modules include a right earpiece housing that anchors a slender pewter microphone boom; its connected tip ends beside her own lip corner, clear against the cheek. A deep-aubergine sleeveless fitted bodice has a standing collar and a loose narrow necktie hanging over its front. Separate forearm sleeves leave visible upper-arm gaps between sleeves and bodice. A short pleated skirt ends above distinct thigh-high stocking tops, with matte ankle boots below. Two thin smoky acrylic wing plates spread behind her back, fixed by exposed root bolts to a pewter waist-back yoke with brackets extending beyond both hip contours. Amber line motifs terminate inside each acrylic plate's edges. Small amber interface marks also sit on headset housings and cuff plates. A vertical full-length frame from a near eye-level three-quarter front viewpoint includes a narrow strip of path around both boot soles. Her eyes meet the camera, lips softly relaxed; the face preserves the reference's eye, nose, lip and jaw relationships. Bright overcast midday light gently models skin and pleats, sharing soft highlights across acrylic and ceramic. Slight residual sway in hair ends and skirt gives the still pose a recent-turn trace, while orchard branches recede softly.
